items.资讯标题: 挑战英伟达 CUDA：亚马逊推出开源工具 TorchNeuron，自研 Trainium 芯片轻松运行 PyTorch 代码
items.desc: 当地时间 10 月 19 日，亚马逊宣布推出开源工具 TorchNeuron，借助该工具，开发人员编写的 PyTorch 代码可以在亚马逊的自研 Trainium 芯片上本地运行，只需更改一次配置，无需重写。英伟达投入了十多年的时间研发 CUDA 工具，能够让 PyTorch 代码在英伟达的芯片上高效运行。亚马逊工程师分别在传统芯片和 Trainium 芯片上运行了相同的 AI 训练脚本。
items.agent_reason: 训练芯片与PyTorch开源生态进展

items.资讯标题: 日本演员工会发布 AI 语音使用准则，龙珠悟空配音演员怒批 AI 盗用其声音
items.desc: 上周，代表日本配音演员的工会发布了一份 AI 使用相关准则，不少配音演员也讲述了这项技术给他们个人与职业带来的困境。部分配音演员支持搭建机制，在获得授权的前提下，将 AI 用于复刻表演者声音的私人场景，但日本配音演员群体对这项技术的主流看法是：它会窃取自己的劳动成果，抢走未来的工作机会。该工会共有约 2600 名配音演员与演员会员，这份准则也是日本首批针对 AI 语音录制发布的行业规范。

items.资讯标题: Nscale 与 Anthropic 洽谈价值 450 亿美元云计算合作协议
items.desc: 据知情谈判人士透露，Nscale 有限公司正与 Anthropic 洽谈算力供应合作，这笔交易总价值有望达到约 450 亿美元。该合作将落地于 Nscale 位于西弗吉尼亚州的 Monarch 数据中心园区的第二座设施，依托英伟达先进的 Vera Rubin AI 芯片，可提供 460 兆瓦的算力支持。这笔交易最快有望在未来数日内敲定，将大幅提升 Nscale 的 IPO 前景，该公司计划在上市时谋求约 300 亿美元的估值。

items.资讯标题: Germany Wants to Lead the World in Industrial AI: How NVIDIA Will Help
items.desc: In the cavernous hall of Kraftwerk, a former power station in Berlin, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang sat down to discuss Germany's AI roadmap, and in particular, the industrial applications of AI. The conversation focused on how Germany can make the most of the AI revolution by playing to its strengths in manufacturing and automotive — and by encouraging AI adoption across the country's ecosystem of small and medium-sized companies. Earlier in the day, as part of the Invest in Germany Summit, Chancellor Merz, the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy and the Federal Ministry for Research, Technology and Space signed a Joint Declaration of Intent with NVIDIA.

items.资讯标题: NVIDIA Advances Agentic Security for Media, From European Public Service Broadcasting to Global Content Production

The initiative now brings in sovereign cloud providers, open model developers and systems integrators to define how broadcasters can deploy agents while keeping control of their data, infrastructure, models and security. Adobe is also advancing GPU-accelerated media ingest using NVIDIA NVENC and NVDEC to accelerate video encoding and decoding, helping production teams process growing media libraries more efficiently.
